## The question you were trying to answer

ccwatch is organised around the questions that cost time — "which session is
blocked on me", "which one says it is working but is not", "what was I in the
middle of". Describing yours in those terms is the fastest route to a good
design.

## What you have to do today instead

## What would corroborate it

A verdict here is never allowed to rest on a single signal, and it is never
allowed to fail quietly. If the new signal is unavailable — no transcript, no
remote, a `gh` that times out — what should the output say? "Say so" is always
an acceptable answer; "show an empty panel" is not.
